1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use; and __a modulation control system configured to modulate valve opening and closing at a frequency greater than 10 Hz to achieve fine pressure control in the brake chamber__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __at least three__ plural first valves and/or plural second valves.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, __wherein the smaller valves operate independently of the larger valves__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed __and are controlled by a dedicated high-frequency control circuit separate from control of the larger valves__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by __proportional or modulating__ binary actuators __capable of intermediate positions between fully open and fully closed states__.

6. (Original) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, __and wherein the control means calculates an individualized optimum braking profile for each wheel based on real-time sensor feedback and stored vehicle dynamics data__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein the control means continuously adjusts valve modulation frequency based on detected wheel slip conditions__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank; __and a central electronic control unit in communication with each air braking unit via a data bus, the central control unit configured to coordinate braking across multiple wheels__.
